description: This file is a C header file declaring prototypes for internal functions related to parsing and handling HTTP messages, specifically for a Simple Message Parser used within a broader system.

methods.name: HttpSmpoLocateFieldData
methods.description: Locates specific field data within an HTTP message body, given a parameter name and boundary, returning handles and offsets for start and end positions.

methods.name: HttpSmpoSaveFieldData
methods.description: Saves field data from an HTTP message to a file, with an option to flush the body after saving.

methods.name: HttpSmpoFindNextBoundary
methods.description: Finds the next boundary in a multipart HTTP message starting from a given offset.

methods.name: HttpSmpoGetFormField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific form field from a multipart HTTP message using the field name.

methods.name: HttpSmpoCopyFormData
methods.description: Copies form data into a buffer, returning the size and length of the data.

methods.name: HttpSmpoCopyFormData2
methods.description: Copies form data between boundaries in a multipart message into a buffer.
